svg.text: Read across the 50% line: new bridges are 8-9, half have dropped below 8 within 5-9 years, below 7 by 35-39 years, below 6 only at 95-99. The steps get longer with age: this is a
cross-section of the 2025 inventory, not one bridge's life, and the worst old bridges have already been replaced or rebuilt (survivor bias). Hover a segment for its bridges and the
cumulative share. Ratings: FHWA Coding Guide items 58-62 (https://doi.org/10.21949/1519105).
